_: Per-page SEO and share metadata for the four landing pages. Lives here rather than only in Shopify so it is reviewable in a diff; push_seo.py writes it to the page records' global.title_tag / global.description_tag metafields, which is where Liquid's page_title and page_description read from. Every claim below already appears in the page body -- nothing here is a new assertion. Written 2026-09-02.

chai.title: תרכיז צ׳אי מסאלה לבתי קפה ומסעדות | GT Everyday
